jobs.title: Expression of Interest
jobs.description: Why we exist We can get food, groceries and rides to our door on demand but accessing healthcare still means battling outdated systems, long waiting lists and travelling to sometimes overstretched clinical facilities. Demand is rising, capacity in clinical settings is not coping, and patients' expectations of how they manage their health have fundamentally changed. That is why Heim exists: to build the AI layer for the last mile of healthcare, and make home the default place for patients to access care, at scale. We surface and optimise unused practitioner availability, then work with healthcare providers to deliver care ranging from blood sample collection to wound dressing, reaching patients where and when they feel most comfortable. About Us We're a team of technologists, clinicians and commercial leaders with a track record of launching, scaling and exiting ventures in cloud technology and healthcare. Before Heim, James Monico and Kelly Klifa built Testing For All, scaling the not-for-profit diagnostics provider into the go-to platform for Covid testing during the pandemic, testing over a million patients in under 18 months. Before that, James co-founded and scaled Cloudreach, exiting to Blackstone in 2017. Dr Elle Clarke, our Medical Director, is a fellow of the 2026 NHS Innovation Accelerator. We've tripled our volume of appointments every period since going live at the end of 2023, and are backed by leading VCs in the space. We now cover 98% of the UK and hold a 4.9/5 patient rating. Why we're asking We're a small but mighty team and are growing quickly, which means roles open at short notice and close fast. jobs.title: Compatibility
jobs.description: CompatibilityWorking at Stripe is not for everyone Not everyone finds success at Stripe. Those who do tend to share a few things in common. The right people donât always think theyâre right Successful Stripes are rigorous thinkers who appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. We want people who are not afraid to be wrong, who can enthusiastically back proposals they initially opposed, and who know how to support decisions with numbers and narrative. We operate in situations of substantial uncertainty and cannot afford either timidity or recklessness. The global financial system can seem like a mystifying domain. It isnât. Itâs made of people and computers, like many other systems youâve worked on. Most Stripes donât come from finance, and theyâve thrived by bringing fresh perspectives. We want generalists who can parachute anywhere into our operations, learn a new field quickly, and execute competently beyond their formal remit. We know that we canât be successful without nurturing the careers of both generalists and experts. People who thrive in high-conflict work environments often do not enjoy the experience here. We try to embrace kindness while still encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Who is Stripe for? Ambitious builders Weâre building solutions without clear precedent, solving problems with far-reaching consequences. The people here find that energizing, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Adaptable problem solvers AI is changing how the global economy works, how our customers work, and how Stripes work. The people who thrive here adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. Rigorous thinkers We argue from first principles, question assumptions, and donât stop at good enough. At Stripe, craft isnât a nice-to-haveâitâs the standard. The most successful Stripes are the people who have the intellectual horsepower, the curiosity to learn a very complicated business, and the humility to get up every day and realize thereâs a huge amount of things they donât know. Conor McNamaraHead of EMEA What all Stripes have in common Weâre dedicated to our work and optimistic about the world. We believe entrepreneurship and free markets do good, and building what supports them matters. If thatâs you, read on. Motivated by our mission Stripe is on a mission to grow the GDP of the internet. Ask Yourself: Do I see free markets and entrepreneurship as powerful forces for advancing progress? Does enabling entrepreneurship and helping to unlock the internet economyâs full potential seem like a compelling use of my time and talents? Embody our operating principles âUsers firstâ is a cornerstone principle. Our users trust us to provide an essential service, and itâs a heavy responsibility that we take very seriously. Ask Yourself: Am I motivated to move mountains to protect and support businesses that depend on Stripe? Am I driven to overcome obstacles and take on big things to drive progress, or do I feel overwhelmed by the sheer scale and breadth of sometimes nebulous opportunities? Energized by change The pace of change at Stripe and in the broader economy is accelerating. Youâll work outside your domain, take on problems that didnât exist a year ago, and be expected to adapt as quickly as the world does. Ask Yourself: Do I see a fast-moving environment as an opportunity rather than an obstacle? Am I comfortable taking on problems outside my domain or experience? Collaborative, multidisciplinary work Building programmable financial infrastructure from first principles is inherently complex. It means that everything we create requires deep, collaborative, multidisciplinary work: technically, organizationally, and geographically. Ask Yourself: Am I excited by navigating complexity at scale? How we operate Youâll bring high standards to everything you do and find others who do the same. Users first

jobs.title: Menu
jobs.description: As Abraham Lincoln once said, âThe best way to predict the future is to create it.â If you want to advance your career but donât know where to start, here are some things you can do to get promoted at work. By Michele Reynolds Be a Model Employee Rule number one for being a good employee is to always be on time and ready to go. Even if you work in a culture that runs behind schedule, itâs better to be on timeâor even earlyâeach day and to every meeting. If youâre leading the meeting, show up with an agenda and be an active timekeeper. Itâs a sign that youâre organized, respect peopleâs time, and serve as a role model to peers. At the end of the meeting, give a quick recap and identify next steps. Solve Problems, Donât Just Identify Them One of the best ways to stand out as a budding leaderâregardless of your current roleâis to be self-sufficient and demonstrate solid judgment. Doing so wonât just set you apart as a critical asset to your team but also serve as a tactic to further develop your leadership skills. A helpful mantra is, âBe a problem solver, not a problem identifier.â When you raise an issue to your boss, also propose a solution. Busy leaders often get bogged down by solving every problem their team faces. Do your boss a favor and find workarounds rather than just surface issues. Respect Your Bossâs Time Be considerate of your bossâs time. Before asking for help, consider the level of urgency and try solving the problemâor at least brainstorm a plan of action to run by your manager. Making an attempt first will demonstrate you know how to take initiative. For things that require your bossâs intervention but arenât time-sensitive, keep a running list of items to discuss. Ask if you can get some time on your managerâs calendar and outline what youâd like to discuss in your meeting invite so you both come prepared. Donât Be a Squeaky Wheel Perhaps most important is a can-do attitude. Anything you can do to minimize your bossâs workload will likely benefit you in the long run. You can help by volunteering to take on something new or brainstorm solutions when a crisis pops up. Baseball great Wade Boggs once said, âA positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events, and outcomes. Itâs a catalyst, and it sparks extraordinary results.â So, whatever you do, donât be a whiner. Even if youâre feeling stressed, save your venting for a friend and present a positive front to your boss. Serve as a Vault Earn trust by keeping information about confidential or sensitive subjects to yourself. Beyond that, donât gossip or backstab at the water cooler. By being a stand-up employee, youâll earn trust and respect. Make Your Boss Look Good Staying organized and moving quickly can make you, and your boss, look good. But donât move too fast. Getting things done efficiently is important, but quality matters, too. Ensure your work represents your company well. If you take on additional responsibilities, confirm they align with whatâs expected of you. Your work reflects on your boss, so make sure theyâre proud of you and your product. Ask for Advice It may seem counterintuitive, but asking your boss for advice can yield dividends. According to research (pdf) by Harvard Business School Professor Alison Wood-Brooks, âIndividuals perceive those who seek advice as more competent than those who do not.â Timed right, asking your boss for guidance can work to your advantage. Speak Up As Aristotle said, âThereâs only one way to avoid criticism: Do nothing, say nothing, and be nothing.â Since youâre reading this article, you clearly want to stand out, so speak up. Confidently sharing your views and expertise in conversations or meetings allows you to demonstrate your knowledge and skills. You can also make an impression on your colleagues and superiors. jobs.title: Operativer Einkauf
jobs.description: Wer wir sind: Wir entwickeln die Intelligenz, die es Robotern ermöglicht, die reale Welt wahrzunehmen, zu verstehen und in ihr zu handeln – über das Labor hinaus und hinein in den industriellen Alltag, etwa in Lagerhallen und Fabriken. Unsere Technologie schließt die Automatisierungslücken, an denen klassische Systeme scheitern. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Art und Weise, wie körperliche Arbeit verrichtet wird, neu zu denken, und suchen neugierige, mutige Köpfe, die die Zukunft der Robotik gemeinsam mit uns gestalten wollen. Überblick: Wir suchen eine prozessorientierte Person, die im operativen technischen Einkauf, das kaufmännische Fundament unserer innovativen Robotiklösungen bei Sereact stärkt. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere internen kaufmännischen Abläufe und bist ein echtes Organisationstalent, das sich gerne mitten ins Geschehen stürzt und dafür sorgt, dass unser Tagesgeschäft im Hintergrund reibungslos läuft. Die Stelle ist in Stuttgart angesiedelt und eignet sich ideal für jemanden, der gerne strukturierte Prozesse aufbaut, kaufmännische Aufgaben steuert und ein Team unterstützt, das an modernster Technologie arbeitet. Deine Aufgaben: Projekt- und Auftragsmanagement: Du steuerst unsere Projekte aus kaufmännischer Sicht, von der ersten Bestellung bis zur finalen Lieferung. Einkauf und Materialwirtschaft: Du unterstützt die Beschaffung von Komponenten und pflegst enge Beziehungen zu unseren Lieferanten. Bestandsmanagement: Du behältst unsere Lagerbestände im Blick und stellst sicher, dass alle Komponenten zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind. Allgemeine Administration: Von der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung bis zur Stammdatenpflege sorgst du dafür, dass unser Tagesgeschäft reibungslos läuft. Qualifikationen: Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Industriekaufmann/zur Industriekauffrau oder ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre. Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer kaufmännischen oder operativen Rolle. Mindset: Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Keine Aufgabe ist dir zu klein oder zu komplex, wenn das Team Unterstützung braucht. Antrieb: Deine Motivation und Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als tiefgehendes Branchenwissen in der Robotik. Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, idealerweise Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. Unser Interviewprozess: Bewerbung Cultural-Fit-Interview (40 Min.): Ein Gespräch darüber, wie du arbeitest, was dich motiviert und wonach du suchst. Es erwarten dich Fragen zu deinem Lebenslauf, deinem „Warum" und Zeit für deine eigenen Fragen. Fachliches Interview (45 Min.): Ein tieferer Einblick in deine Fähigkeiten und deinen Problemlösungsansatz für diese Rolle. Gespräch mit den Gründern: Du triffst einen unserer Gründer, um über die Rolle und deinen Werdegang zu sprechen. Eine gute Gelegenheit, mehr über die Vision von Sereact zu erfahren, Fragen zu stellen und ein klares Gefühl für unsere Unternehmenskultur und Arbeitsumgebung zu bekommen. Was wir bieten: Wellpass (Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft) Flexible Arbeitszeiten Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice bei Bedarf Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur Attraktive Vergütung und hervorragende Karrieremöglichkeiten Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. Location: Remote - Germany From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere! We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About the Role: As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management. You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements. This is an ideal role for someone who brings deep technical expertise, thrives in high-ownership environments, and is excited to shape the future of DevOps. What you'll be doing: Own and evolve our DevOps and platform engineering function, from build and deployment pipelines to monitoring, infrastructure as code, and cost optimization. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that are secure, scalable, and built to support rapid product iterations without sacrificing stability. Improve observability via Datadog, GCP, and custom dashboards, including FinOps focused observability outcomes. Implement and maintain FinOps governance, including showback and chargeback models, to drive cost accountability across engineering teams. Enable developer productivity by creating internal tooling, reusable modules, and simplifying infrastructure for other engineering teams. Help teams define and measure SLOs setting the standard for how we think about system health and reliability. Serve as a FinOps thought leader, collaborating with Product and Engineering to define the most cost-effective architectural patterns for new services and features. Play a key role in shaping our engineering culture, DevOps best practices, and influencing our long-term DevOps roadmap. Work cross-functionally with product engineering, security, finance, and other teams to align technical spending with business unit economics and financial goals. jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer - Munich
jobs.description: About Dash0 Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in. The Opportunity As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to our largest customers and prospects. You'll bridge the gap between product and customer outcomes — designing, demonstrating, and validating Dash0's technical capabilities in real-world enterprise environments. You'll partner with sales and product teams to deliver high-impact Proofs of Concept, guide observability architecture discussions, and ensure customers realize the full technical value of Dash0. Note: Your internal title would be a Solutions Architect. Our Solutions Engineers work across both Pre-Sales and Post-Sales! What You'll Do Design and architect observability solutions leveraging OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies. Translate complex enterprise customer requirements into scalable, performant, and maintainable Dash0 implementations. Develop and execute Proofs of Concept (POCs) that highlight Dash0's differentiated technical capabilities. Deliver engaging technical demos and presentations tailored to engineering and executive audiences. Collaborate closely with Enterprise Account Executives throughout the sales cycle to position Dash0 as the technical solution of choice. Provide architecture guidance and best practices for observability setup, telemetry data modeling, and OpenTelemetry collector design. Create and maintain reusable demo environments, reference architectures, and POC templates. Partner with Product Management to provide technical insights that influence roadmap and feature priorities. What You Bring Deep technical knowledge in Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, observability pipelines, and distributed tracing. Hands-on experience with instrumentation, telemetry data ingestion, and performance optimization. Strong understanding of modern DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering practices. Excellent communication skills — you can explain complex observability concepts clearly to both engineers and executive decision-makers. Ability to create and execute technical demos, architectures, and POCs that prove business value. Collaborative mindset — you work seamlessly across Sales, Product, and Engineering teams. Nice to Have Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot) for collaboration and pipeline visibility. Contributions to technical content — blog posts, conference talks, or open-source documentation. Familiarity with the CNCF ecosystem and community. Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment. Why Dash0 This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started. If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it. jobs.title: (Junior) Data & Automation Manager - Energy Operations (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über uns Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser . In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur. Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG). Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance: Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer, ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität. Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt. Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus. Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS. Dein Profil Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups ( idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement gesammelt und ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI/LLM-Agents (z. B. Python, APIs, Umgang mit größeren Datenmengen) Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis ; Freude daran, Datenqualitätsprobleme systematisch und datenbasiert zu durchdringen Lust auf inhaltliche Tiefe: Du findest es reizvoll, ein komplexes, regulatorisch dichtes Feld wirklich zu durchdringen, statt an der Oberfläche zu optimieren. Vorkenntnisse in der Energiewirtschaft sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung - Neugier und Einarbeitungstempo zählen mehr Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: du gibst dich nicht mit „Job abgeschlossen" zufrieden, sondern prüfst, ob das Ergebnis inhaltlich stimmt Eigenverantwortung und Ownership-Mentalität: du übernimmst einen Bereich, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten; und strebst danach, dein volles Potenzial in diesem Bereich zu entfalten Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend Deine Aufgaben Mission der Rolle Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten -Geschäft von VREY. Mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen , Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren . Du siehst den unmittelbaren Effekt deiner Arbeit - jedes gelöste Energiedaten-Ticket bringt ein Projekt näher an die Abrechnung, jeder gebaute Agent spart dem ganzen Team Zeit. 1. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain end to end ML pipelines in Vertex AI, ensuring that models move seamlessly from prototype to production ready, monitored, cost efficient, and compliant pipelines. jobs.description: <h2>About us</h2> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, we believe the future of technology isn't just smart, it has agency. We're moving past passive tools and building human-centred digital services and products: systems that reason, plan, and act around the people who use them. Our work spans autonomous systems at the frontier of biology, sensing, and AI.</p> <p>We hire self-motivated builders, not ticket-takers. If you thrive in highly agile environments, can cut through ambiguity with first-principles thinking, and want to ship things that matter, this is the kind of place where you'll feel at home.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>You'll be working on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling problems no one else can solve.</p> <p>Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.</p> <p>You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.</p> <p>There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).</p> <p>Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.</p> <h2>What we ask of you</h2> <p>The examples below describe the core domains our AI Engineers own within the Digital Services team. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.</p> <p><strong>Rapid Client Prototyping:</strong> Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, rather than describing it in slide decks.</p> <p><strong>Domain Translation &amp; Integration:</strong> Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.</p> <h2>Indicators you'll be a good fit</h2> <p><strong>Applied AI Expertise:</strong> You have hands-on experience utilising multi-agent frameworks, long-t

jobs.title: Senior Business Value Consultant
jobs.description: <p class="p1"><strong data-start="234" data-end="362">Hybrid role (3 days in the office, 2 days remote), based in our London office at HYLO, 103–105 Bunhill Row, London EC1Y 8LZ.</strong></p> <p>At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?</p> <p>We are looking for a dynamic, analytical, and customer-focused <strong>Sr. Business</strong> <strong>Value Consultant</strong>&nbsp;to join our Sales Organization. In this role you will work closely with our solutions engineers, sales teams, and customers, building strong business cases focused on ROI, NPV, and Payback metrics. Candidates should have in-depth analysis and presentation skills along with the ability to think dynamically about problems, products, and solutions.</p> <h5><strong>As a Sr. Business Value Consultant in JFrog, you will...</strong></h5> <ul> <li>Partner with our enterprise sales teams and customers to articulate the value of JFrog solutions, focusing on business outcomes and ROI.</li> <li>Lead, build, and deliver compelling business cases that translate complex technology solutions into tangible business benefits.</li> <li>Enable enterprise and midmarket sales teams on business value engineering tools and processes to scale the value engineering practice.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and marketing teams to ensure that value propositions align with market needs.</li> <li>Conduct market research to stay abreast of industry trends and competitive insights.</li> <li>Analyze the value and differentiate between Self Hosted and SaaS solutions using uptime productivity, TCO, and Business Value.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h5><strong>To be a Sr. Business Value Consultant in JFrog you need...</strong></h5> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree required; MBA is preferred.</li> <li>A minimum of 5 years of experience in a business value, management consulting, value engineering, or pre-sales / solution engineering capacity.</li> <li>Experience in a technology-focused SaaS sales environment, preferably with cloud economics, DevOps, cybersecurity, or software supply chain solutions.</li> <li>Financial modeling and spreadsheet-based data analysis skills, with experience building ROI and TCO analyses, particularly in situations where clean customer data is scarce</li> <li>Exceptional discovery skills: you know how to ask the right questions to uncover pain, priorities, and value levers without making customers feel interrogated</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills across audiences — you can turn a data-driven analysis into a compelling narrative for a CFO, facilitate a technical workshop, or navigate executive conversations across cultures and geographies with equal confidence</li> <li>Experience working with enterprise or strategic accounts in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Investment Content & Communications Manager
jobs.description: <p><strong>Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.</strong></p> <p>Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.</p> <p>Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.</p> <p>If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.</p> <p><strong>Senior Investment Content &amp; Communications Manager</strong></p> <p>Moonfare’s audience doesn’t read for entertainment. Private Office investors, family offices, GP Services partners and sophisticated individuals read for edge — and they can tell institutional-grade thinking from filler in a sentence. This role exists to produce the editorial output that earns their attention: writing they would bookmark and forward to a peer.</p> <p>You will own Moonfare’s content slate and lead the editorial agenda that carries our point of view on private markets. We have a clear house view; your job is to help set it, research it and bring it to life — from a fund thesis to a market shift to proprietary research. You will be accountable for the signals that matter: finish rate, repeat readership, share rate and newsletter engagement above the editorial threshold. Not page views. The challenge is a sceptical, expert audience and a regulated product. The opportunity is end-to-end ownership of the editorial journey, direct access to investors, GPs and the deal pipeline, and the standing to set the terms of the conversation.</p> <p>You join Moonfare’s Marketing team — lean and high-output, building the brand, generating demand and driving investor acquisition across global markets. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Senior Product Designer @ Secfix Location: Remote (EMEA) · CET/CEST timezone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. How do you feel about owning a feature from the first customer conversation to the version that's live on production — writing the spec yourself, pairing closely with engineers through the build, and overseeing your design shipped on production exactly the way you designed it? If that sounds like the right shape of the job — designer who owns, not designer who hands off — read on. I've spent most of my career believing the best designers aren't the ones with the prettiest Figma files. They're the ones who can frame a problem, write a spec, sit with engineers through the build, and own that what shipped is what they designed. Our founding product designer, Ghada , has been doing exactly that since we started. The engineering team has doubled and we're shipping faster than we ever have. We're hiring the second designer because there's more good work to do than one person can hold — and we'd rather ship twice as much than slow down. Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it. Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months. We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to European market leadership. This space is not threatened by AI, it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of product design work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more. What we believe Compliance software has historically been built like the audit it automates — heavy, defensive, ugly. We're building something else. The customer is a real person trying to ship audit-ready evidence on a Friday afternoon. The product should respect their time, automate the boring parts, and make the rest feel calm. Quality is the product. Most of our category competes on feature lists. We compete on craft. A clear empty state, a sync that doesn't lie, a settings page that holds together at eleven permission tiers — these are the things customers feel before they can name them. Design at Secfix is not what wraps the product. It's most of what makes it work. What the role is We expect strong design skill, strong product thinking, and the ability to hold your own in a technical discussion. You work in a small team — usually with one or two engineers — and pair closely from the first prototype through to production. You own the project from beginning to end. Alongside the features you ship, you do three things that make everyone else faster: Maintain the components and patterns that make design fast. Own how the team ships. We have no PMs. You write the specs, run the ticketing workflow, keep engineers unblocked. Build the tools and skills — Cursor rules, design QA skills, prompt templates — that let engineers do good design work without you in the room. The leverage is doing all four well. Doing only one is the wrong shape. How we work No PMs. Designers and engineers run product. You talk to customers, frame the problem, write the spec, decide what ships. Small temporary teams. You plus one or two engineers per project. Whoever is closest to the problem leads. Design leads the logic, engineering tests feasibility. You bring the V1. Engineers push back on what's expensive or risky, start ahead

Du übernimmst fachliche Verantwortung für unser operatives Accounting – von der laufenden Buchhaltung bis zum abschlussreifen Monatsabschluss nach HGB. Gleichzeitig baust du aktiv mit: Insourcing der Buchhaltung, NetSuite-Einführung (~2027), Prozessdesign. Du verwaltest nicht – du gestaltest. Du kannst also remote arbeiten oder in einem der drei Büros in Berlin, Hamburg oder Köln. Gleichzeitig bekommst du einen Gestaltungsraum, den die wenigsten Inhouse-Rollen bieten: Du baust das Fundament – Prozesse und Struktur – für das Insourcing und NetSuite von Grund auf mit. Mobile: We're building our React Native app, and there's plenty to own if that's where your interest is. Platform and architecture: Effect, clean architecture, type-driven design, the AI pipelines behind everything. If that's the part you find interesting, there's real depth here. Production prototyping: Forget spending hours on Figma mocks when you can just prompt a functional UI quickly. You'll test your ideas by pushing live code rather than sharing static designs. Data-backed intuition: You'll use a mix of user empathy and live analytics (PostHog) to find where people get stuck and fix it right away. Real ownership: You'll take features from top to bottom, handling the architecture, the actual coding and the final deployment. Your code goes to real students at real institutions, not to a sandbox. Ship fast, learn faster: You'll push updates out early to see how users react and use that data to iterate. Past examples of things you might build: A Duolingo-inspired daily quiz system that keeps students engaged with their university materials. Complex AI pipelines designed to pull text and visuals from various documents and map those topics into knowledge graphs. A custom authorization engine built to manage the increasing complexity of multiple institutional environments. jobs.title: Lead / Senior Commercial Steering & Planning Manager (B2B) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About the role Zenjob's B2B business grows through three motions: winning new customers, rolling out more of their locations, and expanding volume in the locations we already serve. We can see that growth today. What we can't yet see is how much of it was actually available to us — whether a vertical captured its potential or simply beat an easy comparison. That question has no owner, and no denominator. You'll build both. You own commercial steering for the B2B business — the numbers the CEO, Commercial Management and CFO decide on, and the baseline that makes those numbers mean something. What you'll work on Commercial steering. Making the B2B organisation steerable: one consistent set of numbers across four verticals, a metrics framework people trust, and early warning before a drift shows up in a quarterly result. Dashboards are how it's delivered, not what the job is. The potential baseline. Locations, shift volume and staffing budget per customer — so growth is measured against what was there, not against last year. Where capacity goes. The other half of the growth question: whether AM time and sales focus sit on the accounts that justify them. You'll track coverage against potential and revenue per AM hour, and work with the Vertical Heads to rebalance portfolios when they don't line up. Forecasting and planning. Existing demand, new pipeline and expansion modelled as three separate lines instead of one blended number — plus a unit-economics-driven, bottom-up revenue plan built together with Finance. Targets, incentives and accountability. The target and incentive logic across all four verticals — quota design, bonus mechanics, accelerators — together with the funnel reviews where verticals are held to it. One loop: what we ask for, what we pay for, and where we check. It only works if every rep can explain how their own number comes about. From finding to fix. Your analysis doesn't stop at the insight. You work out what's actually driving a gap, hand it to the function that can close it — Enablement for a skill or process fix, our project office for a structural one — and then measure whether it worked. The marketplace view. A standing interface with your B2C Steering counterpart, so commercial ambition stays connected to what we can actually fulfill. What you'll bring 4–7 years in commercial analytics, revenue operations, sales strategy or something comparable — ideally B2B SaaS, marketplace or staffing. You've owned reporting end-to-end, not just contributed to someone else's. You build forecasting and planning models comfortably, and you can defend what they say. You can explain a complex commercial dynamic to someone who doesn't work with numbers all day. You'd rather build the first version of something than maintain the tenth. Why this one is interesting Most steering roles inherit a system and keep it running. This one builds it — you'll define how a four-vertical commercial organisation measures itself, with direct access to the CEO, Commercial Managmenet and CFO. The remit is deliberately clear rather than all-encompassing: pricing sits with Finance, supply steering with your B2C counterpart, cross-functional project delivery with our Commercial Mgmt Office. Your job is the numbers, and what they tell us to do next. jobs.title: Operations Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über uns: Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und temporäre Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen nutzen unsere Plattform, um kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende in Echtzeit zu buchen, während Studierende unsere App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Studierende und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier. Über die Rolle: Als Operations Manager bist du das Herzstück unseres Teams. Du stellst sicher, dass Projekte schnell, smart und effizient mit den richtigen Zenjobbern besetzt werden. Mit klarer Übersicht, hoher Serviceorientierung und einem Blick fürs große Ganze. Deine Aufgaben: Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und Kapazitätsplanung für das Staffing in einem Kundensegment. Dafür koordinierst du ein Team aus motivierten Werkstudenten. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team überwachst du Kundenzufriedenheit auf B2B und B2C Seite. Verantworte große strategische Projekte mit verschiedenen Teams zur Optimierung der Skalierbarkeit unserer Staffing Prozesse. Du automatisiert und baust nachhaltige Systeme. Nutzung und Pflege verschiedener Tools: Google Suite, Slack, Aircall, Asana, n8n und interne Systeme Dein Profil: 2–3 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im operativen Geschäft schnell wachsender Startups oder vergleichbarer Rollen. Operatives Chaos ist für dich kein Stressfaktor, sondern dein Element. Du läufst darin zur Hochform auf, statt zu verzweifeln: Du strukturierst Probleme, löst sie pragmatisch und schaffst Klarheit. So hinterlässt du nachhaltige Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass dieselben Probleme nächste Woche nicht wieder auftauchen. Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an Prozessoptimierung. Du fühlst dich sicher im professionellen Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch und interner Zusammenarbeit teilweise auf Englisch. Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit Marketplace Geschäftsmodellen, wo B2C- und B2B aufeinander treffen. Erste Erfahrung mit KI & Automatisierungs-Tools. Was wir bieten Innovative Mission: Gemeinsam schaffen wir Neues. Arbeite in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem du viel lernst und jede deiner Ideen gehört wird. Einzigartiger Teamgeist: Wir können blind aufeinander vertrauen und feiern alle Erfolge gemeinsam als Team. Urlaub: Erholung und Weiterbildung sind uns wichtig. Deshalb bieten wir 28 Tage bezahlten Urlaub (plus 1 Tag für jeweils 2 Kalenderjahre Betriebszugehörigkeit, maximal 30 Tage), 1 Tag Sonderurlaub für ehrenamtliches Engagement, 5 Tage bezahlten Bildungsurlaub sowie die Möglichkeit zu unbezahltem Urlaub. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir lieben unser nagelneues Büro in Prenzlauer Berg. Manchmal braucht man jedoch ein wenig mehr Flexibilität. Das flexible Arbeitsmodell von Zenjob vereint das Beste aus beiden Welten: Du kannst bis zu 2 Tage pro Woche remote arbeiten (in den ersten 6 Monaten 1 Tag, um ein optimales Onboarding zu gewährleisten). Hunde sind bei uns im Office immer herzlich willkommen. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Kontinuierliche Förderung deiner persönlichen Entwicklung (jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 750 EUR, Mentoring-Möglichkeiten, regelmäßige Gespräche zur Karriereentwicklung). Gesunder Geist im gesunden Körper: Bei uns erhältst du einen Urban Sports Club Zuschuss von 30 EUR, um dich fit zu halten. Immer mobil: Du erhältst monatlich 40 EUR Guthaben für NAVIT, ein nachhaltiges Mobilitätstool für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Bike-Sharing und vieles mehr. Legendäre Events: Quartalsweise Team-Events, Winter- und Sommerpartys, Budget für Geburtstage und Jubiläen unserer Mitarbeitenden. jobs.description: <p><strong>Working Student - Product Engineer</strong></p> <p>Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.</p> <p>As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.</p> <p>The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.</p> <p>This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer “what if?” is to build it, you will fit right in.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Find the right problem: </strong>Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.</li> <li><strong>Shape a focused product slice: </strong>Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.</li> <li><strong>Prototype and iterate quickly: </strong>Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.</li> <li><strong>Design for different kinds of work:&nbsp; </strong>Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.</li> <li><strong>Think end to end:&nbsp; </strong>If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.</li> <li><strong>Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:&nbsp; </strong>Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.</li> <li><strong>Make the learning visible: </strong>Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll be great for this role if</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Student status. </strong>You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.</li> <li><strong>Modern web development skills. </strong>You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. jobs.title: (Senior) Controller – Produktion & Supply Chain Management (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Zur Verstärkung unserer Crew suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen  (Senior) Controller – Produktion & Supply Chain Management (m/w/d) . Wer wir sind? Na, wer kennt uns nicht? Im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes sind wir in aller Munde. Unser Gewürz Ketchup - ja, der mit dem grünen Deckel - ist eine echte Legende. Aber wusstest du, dass wir noch viel mehr zu bieten haben? Mit über 600 Crew-Mitgliedern an zehn Standorten weltweit sind wir in der Gewürzwelt zuhause. Bei uns heißt es: Immer einen Schritt voraus sein, Herausforderungen spielend meistern & Genuss neu erleben. Genau diese Grundsätze machen uns zu einem zuverlässigen Lieferanten von hochwertigen Produkten in der Lebensmittelherstellung.   Deine Rolle: Die Brücke zwischen Shopfloor und Zahlenwelt Um es gleich vorwegzunehmen: Wir suchen nicht die berühmte „eierlegende Wollmilchsau“. Niemand bringt von Tag eins an alles perfekt mit. Uns ist viel wichtiger, dass Du in einem unserer Kernbereiche – sei es Supply Chain Management, Lean Management oder operatives Controlling – bereits tiefgehende Erfahrungen gesammelt hast und für die angrenzenden Themen das nötige prozessuale und kaufmännische Verständnis mitbringst. In dieser Rolle agierst Du als Business Partner für unsere Fachbereiche. Du verbindest operatives Know-how mit Weitblick und hilfst uns dabei, unsere gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – vom Einkauf über die Produktion bis zur Logistik – im anspruchsvollen Lebensmittelumfeld effizient zu steuern. Was Dir an spezifischem Fachwissen im ein oder anderen Bereich noch fehlt, erarbeiten wir uns gemeinsam! Klingt spannend? Dann nichts wie los! Werde Teil unserer Hela Crew & erlebe selbst, wie es ist, in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das wirklich schmeckt. Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns auf Dich! Hier gestaltest Du aktiv mit: Prozesse verstehen & strukturieren: Du nimmst unsere Prozesse entlang der Wertschöpfung ( Einkauf, Produktion und Logistik ) auf, dokumentierst sie und behältst Schnittstellen sowie Mengengerüste im Blick. Zahlen-zu-Prozess-Denken: Du begleitest unsere Lean- und Continuous-Improvement-Initiativen. Dabei hilfst Du, Optimierungspotenziale im Werk aufzudecken und sie in belastbaren Zahlen greifbar zu machen. Performance Measurement & SCM: Du identifizierst sinnvolle Messpunkte (z. B. Rüstvorgänge, Wareneingänge) und baust gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen aussagekräftige Kennzahlen (wie OEE oder Materialverbrauch) auf. Gleichzeitig hast Du Lagerbestände und Logistikkosten im Blick. Datenbeschaffung & Kalkulation: Du führst Kosten- und Mengendaten aus unseren Systemen (ERP/BI) zusammen, plausibilisierst diese und wirkst daran mit, prozessorientierte Kostensätze und transparente Rechenlogiken abzuleiten. Analysen & Handlungsempfehlungen: Identifikation von Kostentreibern und Effizienzpotenzialen im Werk sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen für die Produktion, Logistik und Einkauf sowie angrenzende Bereiche Deine Basis: Du hast bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung in mindestens einem dieser Bereiche gesammelt: Supply Chain Management, Lean Management/Produktion oder operatives Produktionscontrolling. Das richtige Mindset: Du musst kein reiner Finanz-Experte und Lean-Profi in einer Person sein. Wichtig ist, dass Du das Zusammenspiel der Prozesse ( Einkauf, Produktion, SCM ) verstehst und die Sprache der Operations genauso sprichst wie die der Zahlen. System-Know-how: Du gehst souverän mit Excel um und bringst eine generelle IT-Affinität für ERP-Systeme (z. B. SAP oder vergleichbar) sowie idealerweise für moderne BI-Tools (z. B. Power BI) mit. Persönlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigeninitiative und eine positive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise. Du bist belastbar, zuverlässig und kommunizierst sicher mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern. Branchenwissen (Nice-to-have): Erfahrung im Lebensmittel- oder FMCG-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Auch kluge Köpfe aus anderen produzier

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Forecasting & Elasticity (m/f/x)
jobs.description: Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste. Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet. The Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science & Analytics team. You will own the forecasting and price elasticity models at the core of rebuy's pricing engine models that directly shape commercial decisions across the business. We care about outcomes, not just predictions: the work you do ships and moves the numbers that matter. We're scaling our impact significantly and need your expertise to take these models further. You'll own the full end-to-end lifecycle: from business context and model research to automated pipelines and retraining, working closely with senior leadership to translate model insights into commercial strategy. Key Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end forecasting and price-elasticity models at the core of our pricing engine — from feature and model research through evaluation, deployment, and continuous monitoring Scale the forecasting architecture to meet growing demand for granular, product-level forecasts Design and run pricing experiments and A/B tests, and turn the results into clear, strategic recommendations for leadership Generate commercial insights through deep-dive analyses of pricing elasticity, customer behavior, market dynamics, and competitive positioning Partner with senior stakeholders across Commercial, Marketing, Product, and Operations to surface opportunities and solve complex business problems Establish best practices for analytics, experimentation, commercial decision-making, and AI usage — and automate the reporting that keeps models and decisions visible Requirements: 5+ years in a Data Science role , ideally in e-commerce or marketplace environments, solving a range of real business problems (we care about what you've built, not your exact title or tenure) A quantitative degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modeling, and machine learning, with hands-on Python and SQL Hands-on experience with time series forecasting — modeling, feature engineering, and evaluation Experience designing and running A/B tests and experiments with measurable business impact A proactive, self-starting mindset — you own a domain end-to-end and care about pricing, forecasting, and e-commerce dynamics Strong stakeholder management and comfort presenting to and influencing senior leadership Preferred: You use AI tools daily to work faster and push what's possible Knowledge of causal inference methods and advanced experimental design Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) Experience in sustainability-focused or circular economy businesses Location: Berlin Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 2 days a week) Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy: Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time. Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome. Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed. Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin). Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave. Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours,

Bring neue Ideen, moderne Tools und frischen Wind mit ein und perfektioniere unsere Gestaltung. jobs.title: Product Engineer — Working Student
jobs.description: Working Student - Product Engineer Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents. As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test. The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners. This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer "what if?" is to build it, you will fit right in. What you'll do Find the right problem: Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first. Shape a focused product slice: Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful. Prototype and iterate quickly: Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better. Design for different kinds of work:  Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products. Think end to end:  If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday. Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:  Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result. Make the learning visible: Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version. You'll be great for this role if Student status. You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin. Modern web development skills. You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work all count. Product-minded builder. You care about the user's goal and accessibility, and can turn an ambiguous problem into the simplest useful solution, test it and iterate. Full-stack and AI curiosity. You want to learn how APIs, data and services turn an interface into a reliable product, and can use AI-assisted tools while still understanding, checking and owning the result. Clear, team-first communication. You can explain what you built end to end, make technical choices understandable, ask for input and respond well to feedback. Nice to have Backend and integration foundations. Some experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, databases, APIs, serverless functions, Supabase, Firebase, AWS
